text:
ana_p: Heads-up — proposing a rollout plan for latency-aware per-tenant routing (helps premium tenants go to low-latency pools when available). Want a short, operational playbook + gating metrics. Thoughts? :eyes:

liang_eng: +1. We should do a small tenant-canary first (2% of tenants), not percent of requests. Per-tenant isolation reduces blast radius.

mike_sre: Agree on tenant-canary. Operational gates: p95 latency delta, 5xx rate, and queue length on the low-latency pool. If any breach -> immediate rollback to region-default.

nora_data: For A/B measurement, we can run a matched cohort: similar traffic shape tenants split into variant/control. Need telemetry events: route.variant, route.fallback_reason, token_cost. I'll sketch dashboards.

katie_cs: Heads-up from CS: two customers already asked for this; they want an opt-in during beta and a customer toggle in Console. We should add a checkbox in tenant settings.

sam_security: Security notes: routing metadata must not include user prompt bodies in logs. Mask tenant ids in long-term logs. Also add an audit trail for flag flips.

liang_eng: Proposal for rollout stages:
1) Internal dev + staging smoke (0 tenants)
2) Canary tenants (2 tenants, manual opt-in) for 24h
3) Tenant-slice canary (2% of eligible tenants) for 72h with telemetry gating
4) Gradual ramp to 20% over 7 days if stable
5) GA opt-in (Console + API flag)

mike_sre: Suggested automatic fallback policy (enforced by router):
- On sustained p95 > baseline + 20ms for 1m -> route to fallback pool for that tenant
- On pool OOM or node failure -> immediate fallback to regional default
- On repeated fallbacks >3 in 1h -> disable feature flag for tenant and alert owners

liang_eng: Here's a minimal feature-flag config we'll use in the infra (pseudo YAML):

```
flag: latency_route_v1
variants:
  - default
  - low_latency
canary:
  tenants: ["beta-ops", "redwood-internal"]
  percent_of_tenants: 2
gates:
  - p95_latency_delta_ms < 10
  - error_rate_pct < 0.5
kill_switch: true
telemetry_keys: ["route.variant","route.fallback_reason","pool_id"]
```

liang_eng: SDK evaluation sample (node):
```
const flag = await flags.evaluate('latency_route_v1', { tenant_id: 'acme' })
if (flag.variant === 'low_latency') {
  routeTo('low-latency-pool')
} else {
  routeTo('default')
}
```

nora_data: Metrics to gate on (primary + secondary):
- Primary: p95 latency increase vs baseline (tenant-specific), request success rate (5xx)
- Secondary: CPU/GPU utilization on low-latency pool, mean queue time, token cost delta
We will compute a relative delta per-tenant to avoid noisy absolute thresholds.

katie_cs: For customer comms: draft note explaining opt-in beta, expected improvements, and how to revert. Align on SLAs: beta won't change contractual SLA but we need guardrails.

sam_security: Also confirm KMS usage for tenant routing metadata in Private deployments. No cross-tenant telemetry mixing.

mike_sre: Ops checklist before tenant slice canary:
- Alert: p95 delta > configured -> P0 pager (route fallback automated)
- Dashboard: per-tenant p50/p95/p99 + fallback_count
- Runbook: how to remove tenant from low-latency pool manually
- Capacity: reserve 10% spare capacity in low-latency pool for rollbacks

ana_p: small nit: feature flag naming -> use `routing.latency.v1` to keep namespaces consistent. Also add `owner: product/ana_p` and `contacts` field.

liang_eng: Good call. We'll add an automated drift check that validates gates are still sensible after 24h of data. If gate thresholds are too tight, warn but don't auto-close.

nora_data: A/B analysis plan: run pairwise tests for matched tenants, bootstrap confidence intervals for latency and cost. Report after 72h of canary and at 20% ramp.

katie_cs: I'll prepare a customer-facing opt-in flow and an FAQ. Need devex to expose a quick toggle in Console + API.

liang_eng: Devex / console folks: sample API patch to flip flag via Admin API:
```
PATCH /admin/tenant/{tenant_id}/flags
body: { "routing.latency.v1": "low_latency" }
```
Devbot: deploy started for feature flag infra update. (deploy-1234) :rocket:

mike_sre: final ask: include an emergency kill switch in the Console (global) that immediately forces all tenants to `default` variant and emits an audit event.

sam_security: +1 on kill switch. Also add retention policy: routing debug logs kept 7d, aggregated metrics 90d.

ana_p: Action items: 1) liang to own infra changes and rollout script; 2) nora to create dashboards and experiment plan; 3) katie to draft comms + Console UX; 4) mike to publish runbook and alerts; 5) sam to sign off on telemetry privacy. Target: start staging next week, tenant-canary in two weeks.

liang_eng: I'll open the RFC + rollout playbook PR today and tag everyone.

katie_cs: sounds good. I'll line up the two pilot customers and get legal/ops notified. :thumbsup:

nora_data: I'll post the initial dashboard links once the metrics pipeline is wired.

devbot: deploy success: feature-flag-service updates live in staging (deploy-1234)

ana_p: Thanks all — keeping this thread for final signoffs.
